about_the_game:
[Stand-Alone: EP.0 Demo] is a demo version that offers you a rich and fun gaming experience.

It includes the following features, which you might want to take note of:

1. It's very stable, allowing you to replay the content multiple times and experience different combat and skill combinations.

The demo can offer at least 2-3 hours of gameplay.

You'll have access to a default weapon and challenging combat content, where you can become stronger through skill collection and combination.

2. Some fragmented narrative storytelling.

Contains clues

In the demo, you will encounter some fragmented storyline, though it is minimal and cryptic in this version. You may need to piece together the clues in the full version of the game to uncover the real backstory. Of course, you can ignore this aspect and still enjoy the combat.

3. Challenging combat.

Try beating it!

In the demo, we've adjusted the difficulty to let you start a journey from a new level. This is our experimental hard mode. Don't worry, this isn't the final difficulty, but we want it to be quite challenging here.

4. We need your feedback.

Join our community!

We hope for more skill combinations and creativity, and we need the help of players like you. Please contact us through our homepage, join our community, and participate in discussions.

Thank you for playing and for your support!

Lifuel
